moments.text: Wide infrared view looking down on rows of clouds, orange crosshair and corner brackets at centre. Black boxes mask parts of the edges.
The picture goes flat grey for about 0.3 s, then returns zoomed in on a bright cloud bank over darker sea.
A small white spot emerges from behind the upper-left black box and moves down and right toward the crosshair.
The spot slips past the crosshair on its upper left and drifts to the far left of the frame, over the cloud bank.
The view swings back: the spot moves right across the cloud and settles on the crosshair.
The spot stays near the crosshair, over broken cloud and then open sea, ending just above and right of it.
